from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
src=np.array(Image.open('outputs/v0/summer-form-story-1080x1920.png').convert('RGB'))
out=np.array(Image.open('outputs/v3/summer-form-story-registration-up-1080x1920.png').convert('RGB'))
diff=np.any(src"'!=out,axis=2)
ys,xs=np.where(diff)
print('"'diff_pixels',int(diff.sum()))
print('diff_bbox',int(xs.min()),int(ys.min()),int(xs.max()+1),int(ys.max()+1))
# Exact original glyph pixel reuse after a 260 px upward move.
r=src[:,:,0].astype(int); g=src[:,:,1].astype(int); b=src[:,:,2].astype(int)
blue=(b-r>15)&(b-g>5)&(r<220)
mask=blue[970:1210,560:1005]
sy,sx=np.where(mask)
exact=np.array_equal(out[970+sy-260,560+sx],src[970+sy,560+sx])
print('glyph_shift_exact',str(exact).lower())
# No navy registration text remains in the old inner cell.
r2=out[:,:,0].astype(int); g2=out[:,:,1].astype(int); b2=out[:,:,2].astype(int)
blue2=(b2-r2>15)&(b2-g2>5)&(r2<220)
print('old_text_region_navy_pixels',int(blue2[970:1210,560:1005].sum()))
# Pixels outside the declared local edit region are identical.
allowed=np.zeros(diff.shape,dtype=bool); allowed[718:1220,550:1007]=True
print('outside_locked_region_diff_pixels',int((diff & ~allowed).sum()))
